description: Canonical reusable effect vocabulary for Dojo Deckbuilder. Card-family registries reference these stable effect IDs. This file defines shared mechanical meaning; card-specific timing, values, conditions, and dedicated resolver details remain with the card entry.

policy.stability: Effect IDs are public canonical identifiers. Do not rename an existing ID merely for style; add a replacement through an explicit migration if semantics truly change.
policy.reuse: Use an existing effect ID whenever the mechanical outcome is the same. Do not create family-specific synonyms for shared mechanics.
policy.extension: If no effect accurately describes a mechanic, propose a new canonical effect here before using it in a family registry.
policy.customEffects: core.custom is the escape hatch for genuinely bespoke behavior. It requires a named resolver and must not be used when an existing reusable effect plus conditions can express the behavior.
policy.conditions: Condition identifiers are also canonical. New condition names must be added to this file before card-family registries use them.
policy.runtimeCompatibility: During Stage 3B, the generator may expand an effect reference into the legacy action/target/duration fields consumed by the current engine. Family sources should prefer the effect reference as the semantic authority.

triggers.onPlay: When the card is played and its immediate play effect begins resolving.
triggers.onHit: After an Attack is determined to Hit.
triggers.onBlock: After an Attack is determined to be Blocked and deal zero final combat damage.
triggers.afterResolve: After the source card has finished its primary resolution.
triggers.onEquip: When a permanent is equipped or enters the equipped area.
triggers.onPurchase: When a card is successfully acquired during Ascend.
triggers.onInitiate: During the controller's Initiate phase at the relevant timing window.
triggers.onHide: During the controller's Hide phase at the relevant timing window.
triggers.onAttackDeclared: When an Attack and its zone are declared, before final Hit/Block resolution.
triggers.onDefenseDeclared: After the defender chooses or declines a Defense for the declared Attack.
triggers.passive: Continuous or reaction-enabling behavior that is checked whenever its condition is relevant.

targets.opponent: The opposing fighter / opposing board state.
targets.source: The card or action producing the effect.
targets.chosen-card: A card selected by the resolving effect.
targets.chosen-equipment: A permanent Equipment card selected by the resolving effect.

durations.immediate: Applies only while the current effect or calculation resolves.
durations.nextAttack: Persists until the affected fighter's next Attack consumes it.
durations.nextDefense: Persists until the affected fighter's next Defense consumes it.
durations.endOfTurn: Persists through the current turn and expires at its end / Hide cleanup as appropriate.
durations.endOfRound: Persists through the current round and expires at the next Honor transition.
durations.nextHonor: Persists until the next Honor phase performs its reset/refresh processing.
durations.whileEquipped: Persists while the source permanent remains equipped and active.

conditionOperators.gte: actual is greater than or equal to expected
conditionOperators.lte: actual is less than or equal to expected
conditionOperators.notIncludes: actual collection/string does not include expected

core.draw.description: Draw cards from the controller's deck into their hand, applying the normal deck/discard reshuffle rules.

core.discard.description: Move cards from a hand or other explicitly selected legal source to that fighter's discard pile.

core.destroy.description: Remove a card from its owner's normal deck cycle and place it in the destroyed/removed area defined by the rules.

core.heal.description: Restore HP to the affected fighter without exceeding that fighter's current Max HP unless another canonical rule explicitly changes the cap.

core.gainFocus.description: Add Focus to the affected fighter's current Focus pool and to any applicable generated-Focus history for the current turn.

core.gainXP.description: Grant XP in addition to XP already awarded by global Attack, Defense, KO, or other canonical rules.

core.reveal.description: Reveal one or more cards from a specified zone without yet changing ownership or final destination.

core.search.description: Search a specified legal card zone for one or more cards matching the card's canonical filter, then perform the explicitly stated destination/shuffle behavior.

core.shuffle.description: Randomize the order of the explicitly identified deck or card group using the normal shuffle rules.

core.moveCard.description: Move a card between explicitly defined legal zones such as hand, discard, deck, play area, equipment, or destroyed area.

core.choice.description: Present an explicit player choice between mechanically distinct legal outcomes. The resolver must preserve player agency and the AI path must make an explicit policy-driven choice.

combat.modifyAttackPower.description: Modify Attack Power by the signed amount for the specified duration. Positive values increase power; negative values reduce it.

combat.modifyDefense.description: Modify the affected fighter's standing DEF contribution by the signed amount for the specified duration. This is distinct from modifying a Defense card's Guard.

combat.modifyGuard.description: Modify the Guard contribution of a Defense card or defensive effect by the signed amount for the specified duration.

combat.modifySpeed.description: Modify Speed by the signed amount for the specified duration.

combat.dealDamage.description: Deal explicit effect damage separate from normal Attack-vs-Defense combat damage unless the card states otherwise.

combat.preventDamage.description: Prevent or reduce an incoming damage event by the stated amount without retroactively changing whether the Attack Hit unless the card explicitly says so.

combat.piercing.description: Ignore up to the stated amount of DEF supplied by Equipment for the affected Attack. Piercing does not reduce Character DEF unless another rule explicitly says it does.

combat.chooseZone.description: Allow an Attack or defensive declaration to use a legal zone selected by the acting player instead of only its printed default zone.

combat.grantFlow.description: Give the current or next qualifying Attack the Flow keyword. Flow ownership is separate from whether the once-per-turn Flow draw has already been used.

combat.readyTempo.description: Ready the affected fighter's Tempo if it is currently spent. Does not grant more than the normal Tempo capacity unless another canonical rule explicitly does so.

equipment.modifyDefenseContribution.description: Modify the DEF supplied by Equipment/Armor in the affected combat context by the signed amount for the specified duration. This does not modify Character DEF or the Guard contribution of a Defense card or defensive effect. A nextAttack duration is consumed by the next Attack interaction in which the affected Equipment/Armor DEF contribution is evaluated, as defined by the dedicated resolver.

equipment.ready.description: Change exhausted Equipment to ready state so it can be used again when otherwise legal.

equipment.exhaust.description: Change ready Equipment to exhausted state until a rule or effect readies it.

economy.spendFocus.description: Spend Focus from the affected fighter's current pool and record it as Focus spent this turn where relevant. This is distinct from merely setting Focus to a lower value.

economy.modifyCost.description: Modify the Focus cost of the affected purchase, card class, or acquisition by the signed amount for the stated duration; final cost obeys the global minimum-cost rule if one applies.

core.custom.description: Explicit escape hatch for a mechanically unique effect that cannot be faithfully represented by any reusable canonical effect plus conditions.

conditions.firstAttackThisTurn: The source is the controller's first Attack declared this turn.
conditions.firstNormalAttackThisTurn: The source is the controller's first non-Reversal Attack this turn.
conditions.attackNumber: Ordinal number of this Attack in the controller's turn.
conditions.playedKataThisTurn: The controller played at least one Kata earlier this turn.
conditions.previousAttackHit: The controller's immediately previous Attack this turn Hit.
conditions.previousAttackBlocked: The controller's immediately previous Attack this turn was Blocked.
conditions.differentZoneFromPreviousAttack: The declared zone differs from the controller's immediately previous Attack zone.
conditions.priorDifferentZoneCount: Count of distinct prior Attack zones relevant to the current sequence.
conditions.priorLowAttack: A relevant prior Attack this turn used the Low zone.
conditions.previousAttackZoneMidOrHigh: The immediately previous Attack zone was Mid or High.
conditions.priorPunchAttack: A relevant prior Attack this turn has the Punch tag/type.
conditions.priorSpinAttack: A relevant prior Attack this turn has the Spin tag/type.
conditions.priorJumpOrSpinAttack: A relevant prior Attack this turn has the Jump or Spin tag/type.
conditions.previousCardIsItem: The immediately previous card played by the controller this turn was an Item.
conditions.previousCardIsItemOrConsumable: The immediately previous card played by the controller this turn was an Item or Consumable.
conditions.previousCardIsKataOrItem: The immediately previous card played by the controller this turn was a Kata or Item.
conditions.hasWeaponEquipped: The controller currently has at least one Weapon equipped.
conditions.hasImprovisedWeapon: The controller currently satisfies the canonical Improvised Weapon condition.
conditions.targetHasMatchingArmor: The target has Armor/Equipment whose zone matches the declared Attack zone under the canonical matching rules.
conditions.targetHasExhaustedEquipment: The target has at least one exhausted Equipment permanent relevant to the effect.
conditions.targetPermanentEquipmentCount: Number of target permanent Equipment cards currently in play.
conditions.targetTempoUsed: The target's Tempo has already been spent for the relevant round.
conditions.targetSpeedHigher: The target's current Speed is strictly higher than the controller's current Speed.
conditions.hasFewerCardsThanTarget: The controller has fewer cards in the compared zone/hand than the target, as defined by the card effect.
conditions.selfSpeedChangedThisRound: The controller's Speed has changed at least once this round.
conditions.wasHitSinceLastTurn: The controller was Hit after the end of their previous turn and before the current check.
conditions.playedDefenseSinceLastTurn: The controller played a Defense after the end of their previous turn and before the current check.
conditions.blockedSinceLastTurn: The controller Blocked at least one Attack after the end of their previous turn and before the current check.
conditions.blockedThisRound: The controller has Blocked at least one Attack during the current round.
conditions.defenderPlayedDefense: The defender committed a Defense card to the current Attack.
conditions.playedAsReversal: The current Attack was declared through the Reversal timing window.
conditions.hasTempo: The controller's Tempo is currently ready/available.
conditions.isFastest: The controller's current Speed is strictly greater than the opponent's current Speed unless the governing rule says ties qualify.
conditions.oncePerTurn: The effect may successfully resolve no more than once during the controller's current turn.
conditions.focusSpentEarlierThisTurn: The controller spent at least 1 Focus earlier in the current turn.
conditions.focusGeneratedThisTurn: Amount of Focus generated by the controller during the current turn, excluding Focus merely carried or restored by bookkeeping.
conditions.completedBeltExamThisRound: The controller completed a Belt Exam requirement during the current round.
conditions.completesActiveBeltExam: The current resolving action causes the controller's active Belt Exam requirement to become complete.
conditions.yellowBeltExamThirdZone: The current Attack supplies the third distinct required zone for the Yellow Belt Exam.
conditions.boughtCardLastAscend: The controller bought at least one card during their immediately previous Ascend phase.
conditions.nonHonorSceneChangedThisRound: The active Location/Scene changed outside normal Honor processing during the current round.
conditions.alternateZone: Metadata condition carrying an alternate legal zone value for a zone-changing effect.
conditions.incomingZones: Metadata condition listing incoming Attack zones to which a reaction applies.
conditions.choiceKind: Metadata condition naming a structured choice contract handled by a dedicated resolver.
conditions.discardCost: Metadata condition carrying a discard cost required by a dedicated resolver.
conditions.drawAfterCost: Metadata condition carrying a draw quantity granted only after a dedicated choice resolver successfully pays its stated cost; use this for cost-contingent draw rewards rather than unconditional composite draws.
conditions.focusGain: Metadata condition carrying a Focus reward option inside a dedicated choice resolver.
conditions.itemCostPenalty: Metadata condition carrying an Item purchase-cost penalty option inside a dedicated choice resolver.
conditions.defenseGuardPenalty: Metadata condition carrying a Defense Guard penalty option inside a dedicated choice resolver.
conditions.draw: Metadata condition carrying a draw quantity inside a dedicated composite resolver.
conditions.discard: Metadata condition carrying a discard quantity inside a dedicated composite resolver.
conditions.oncePerRound: The effect may successfully resolve no more than once during the current round.
conditions.oncePerGame: The effect may successfully resolve no more than once during the current game.
conditions.minimumBelt: Metadata condition carrying the minimum Belt rank required for the effect to resolve.
conditions.equippedThisTurn: The source Equipment entered the equipped area during the controller's current turn.
conditions.equippedCardIsSource: The Equipment currently entering play is the source Equipment itself.
conditions.equippedCardIsOtherPermanentEquipment: The Equipment currently entering play is a different permanent Equipment controlled by the source's controller.
conditions.equippedCardSubtypeIn: Metadata condition listing Equipment subtypes that qualify for the current equip trigger.
conditions.sourceActivationArmed: A prior activation of this source created the pending conditional effect being checked.
conditions.manualActivation: The effect resolves only after its controller explicitly activates the ready source Equipment at a legal timing window.
conditions.attackUsesSourceEquipment: The current Attack is using or receiving the eligible contribution of the source Weapon/Equipment.
conditions.attackZones: Metadata condition listing declared Attack zones to which an offensive Equipment effect applies.
conditions.attackHasTag: Metadata condition naming a required tag on the current Attack.
conditions.attackHasAnyTag: Metadata condition listing tags of which at least one must be present on the current Attack.
conditions.nextAttackHasTag: Metadata condition naming a required tag on the next Attack that consumes the pending effect.
conditions.defenseHasTag: Metadata condition naming a required tag on the Defense that created the trigger.
conditions.hasTwoPairedWeapons: The controller currently has at least two equipped Weapons with the Paired tag.
conditions.firstHitThisTurn: The current Hit is the controller's first Hit this turn.
conditions.firstHitWithSourceThisTurn: The current Hit is the first Hit this turn made using the source Equipment.
conditions.firstHitWithSourceThisRound: The current Hit is the first Hit this round made using the source Equipment.
conditions.firstQualifyingHitThisTurn: The current Hit is the first Hit this turn satisfying the effect's other qualifying conditions.
conditions.firstCombatDamageWithSourceThisTurn: The current event is the first time this turn the source Equipment contributed to combat damage dealt.
conditions.combatDamageDealt: Exact combat damage dealt by the current Attack after prevention and reduction.
conditions.firstDifferentZoneSequenceThisTurn: This is the first time this turn the controller has produced the qualifying different-zone Attack sequence.
conditions.targetXpHigher: The targeted opposing fighter/player currently has strictly more XP than the controller.
conditions.selfIsLowestXp: The controller is currently tied for or solely has the lowest XP among the compared legal players.
conditions.targetHasTemporaryNegativeStat: The target currently has at least one temporary negative ATK, DEF, or Speed modifier.
conditions.firstAttackAfterKataThisTurn: The current Attack is the controller's first Attack after playing a Kata this turn.
conditions.firstAttackWithTagThisTurn: Metadata condition naming a tag for which the current Attack is the first matching Attack this turn.
conditions.firstDefenseThisRound: The current Defense is the controller's first Defense this round.
conditions.attackedThisTurn: The controller has already made at least one Attack during the current turn.
conditions.firstIncomingAttackThisRound: The current incoming Attack is the first Attack targeting this controller during the round.
conditions.incomingAttackUsesWeapon: The current incoming Attack qualifies as a Weapon Attack under the canonical Weapon rules.
conditions.incomingAttackIsUnarmed: The current incoming Attack qualifies as Unarmed under the canonical rules.
conditions.incomingAttackTargetsSelf: The current incoming Attack legally targets the source Equipment's controller.
conditions.sameOpponentAsBlockedAttack: The pending effect applies only against the opponent whose Attack created the Block trigger.
conditions.didNotAttackPreviousTurn: The controller made no Attack during their immediately previous turn.
conditions.hasNotAttackedThisTurn: The controller has not yet made an Attack during the current turn.
conditions.sceneChangeOccurred: A Scene Change has just resolved at the relevant trigger window.
conditions.nextPurchaseOnly: The cost modifier is consumed by the next qualifying purchase and does not modify later purchases.
conditions.nextItemOnly: The pending modifier is consumed by the next qualifying Item and does not affect later Items.
conditions.marketEndSlot: The chosen Market card occupies either end slot of the current Market row.
conditions.minimumFinalCost: Metadata condition carrying the minimum final Focus cost after the modifier is applied.
conditions.scheduledTiming: Metadata condition naming a delayed expiration or resolution timing handled by the dedicated resolver.
conditions.resolvedCardType: Metadata condition naming the card type whose completed resolution created the trigger.
conditions.examRequirementCompleted: A legal requirement of the controller's active Belt Exam was just completed.
conditions.ascendCompleted: The controller's Ascend phase has just completed.
conditions.boughtCardThisAscend: The controller bought at least one card during the current Ascend phase.
conditions.purchaseCompleted: A legal Market purchase has just completed.
conditions.purchasedCardCost: Printed Focus cost of the card involved in the current purchase event.
conditions.pendingFromSource: A prior effect from this source scheduled the current Initiate reward.
conditions.forcedDiscardEvent: An opponent-controlled effect is currently forcing the controller to discard one or more cards.
conditions.defenseOutsideTurn: The current Defense is being played outside the controller's own turn.
conditions.armedEquipmentZoneMatched: The current Attack uses the zone previously chosen by this source Equipment's armed effect.
conditions.discardedPrintedFocusValue: Printed Focus Value of the card paid/discarded for the current Equipment effect.
conditions.costPaid: The optional cost required by the effect was successfully paid.
conditions.xpFromLegalAttackOrDefense: The XP gain that created the trigger came from a legal Attack or Defense resolution.
conditions.focusGeneratedBySingleCard: Amount of Focus generated by the single card that created the trigger.
conditions.firstNegativeCombatModifierThisRound: The current negative Attack Power or Guard modifier is the first qualifying one affecting the controller this round.
conditions.sourceArmorHelpedBlock: The source Armor/Defense Equipment contributed Defense to an Attack that was Blocked.
conditions.firstArmorBlockThisRound: The current Block is the first qualifying Block this round in which the source Armor contributed.
conditions.sourceAffectedCountThreshold: Metadata condition carrying the number of qualifying affected events after which the source is destroyed or otherwise changes state.
conditions.firstDamageThisRound: The current damage event is the first damage the controller has taken this round.
conditions.firstCombatDamageThisRound: The current event is the first combat-damage event the controller has taken this round.
conditions.incomingDamageAtLeast: Metadata threshold for the unreduced incoming damage amount relevant to the effect.
conditions.sourceExhausted: The source Equipment is currently exhausted.
conditions.targetHpAtMost: Metadata threshold requiring the affected fighter's current HP to be at or below the stated value.
conditions.firstSwapThisGame: The current Equipment swap is the first swap of this source during the game.
conditions.discardedByEffect: The source card is being discarded by a card/effect rather than normal Hide cleanup.
conditions.firstDamagingAttackThisRound: The current incoming Attack is the first Attack this round that deals positive damage to the controller.
conditions.damageSourceIsWeapon: The current damage event was caused by a Weapon Attack/effect as defined by the canonical rules.
conditions.minimumDraw: Metadata floor for the number of cards drawn during the affected Hide draw.
conditions.currentAttackIsNormal: The current Attack is a normal Attack rather than a Reversal or other special Attack timing.
conditions.nextAttackDifferentZone: The next Attack consuming the pending effect must use a different zone from the Attack that created it.
conditions.nextQualifyingAttackOnly: The pending effect is consumed by the next Attack satisfying its other source/qualifier conditions.
conditions.reactionPlayedAgainstSelf: A Reaction was just played against the source Equipment's controller.
conditions.sameTurnOnly: The pending effect expires at the end of the current turn if it has not been consumed.
conditions.sameRoundOnly: The pending effect expires at the end of the current round if it has not been consumed.
